Important: 21+ ID Required at the Door

An adult 21 or older must be present with valid government-issued photo ID (driver's license, state ID, US passport, or military ID) to accept any liquor delivery. The DoorDash or Uber Eats driver will scan or verify the ID before handing over the order. Per Tennessee Alcoholic Beverage Commission regulations, drivers cannot leave alcohol unattended.

Delivery FAQs

Common Questions About Liquor Delivery Near You

Specific to ordering liquor delivery to your address.

If your address is in Murfreesboro, La Vergne, Smyrna, Christiana, Rockvale, or surrounding parts of Rutherford County, Tennessee, liquor delivery from Liquor & Wine Outlet is likely available through DoorDash or Uber Eats. Open either app, enter your delivery address, and search for Liquor & Wine Outlet — the platform will confirm if your address is in the delivery zone.

Most liquor deliveries from Liquor & Wine Outlet at 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro arrive within 30 to 60 minutes during store hours. Live tracking is available in both DoorDash and Uber Eats apps. Distance from the store, time of day, and driver availability all influence the exact ETA.

Liquor delivery is available during Liquor & Wine Outlet's store hours — Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Place an order any time during those windows in DoorDash or Uber Eats. Tennessee law prohibits alcohol delivery outside store operating hours.

Yes. Tennessee law requires that an adult 21 or older with a valid government-issued ID be present at the door to accept an alcohol delivery from Liquor & Wine Outlet. The driver cannot leave the order unattended on a porch or with a non-21+ person. Plan to be at the delivery address when the driver arrives.

You need a valid government-issued photo ID showing you are 21 years or older — typically a driver's license, state ID, US passport, or military ID. The DoorDash or Uber Eats driver will scan or visually verify the ID at the door. If you cannot show valid ID, the driver is required to return the order.

Yes. Liquor & Wine Outlet offers Sunday liquor delivery between 10:00 AM and 11:00 PM. Open DoorDash or Uber Eats during those hours, search for Liquor & Wine Outlet in Murfreesboro, and place your order normally. Sunday delivery times match weekday delivery speed.

Delivery fees and minimum order amounts are set by DoorDash and Uber Eats, not by Liquor & Wine Outlet directly. Check the platform at checkout for current fees, which vary by distance, time of day, and any active promotions. DashPass and Uber One memberships can reduce or eliminate delivery fees.

If DoorDash or Uber Eats shows your address as out of range for Liquor & Wine Outlet delivery, call the store directly at (615) 624-6928 — the team can sometimes arrange in-store pickup or recommend the closest platform that does cover your address. In-store pickup is always available at 2003 SE Broad Street.
